character.temperament: Chill but vicious: small, quiet and unbothered — until she is provoked, and the provocation is her brother Willie's constant meowing. Then she beats him up; she always wins their fights, despite weighing half what he does.

palette.provenance: From Daniel's photos of the real Aggie (cat_kit/reference/reference-aggie-drawer.jpg and reference-aggie-plant.jpg): a dark tortoiseshell (Daniel says calico; the photos show tortie) — warm black-brown base #241C17 (photo median) with irregular orange #B06E2C and cream #BFA87A mottling over the whole coat, a mostly dark face with orange mottling and a cream/orange throat and chest, a dark tail with orange running through it, and green-gold eyes like her brother's. The mottle is a seeded scatter of small flattened ellipsoid shells in the two tones over the dark base, denser on the torso; mottle.seed makes her build identically every run.

character.temperament: A total asshole (the owner's words, affectionate): knocks drinks and his own water bowl everywhere, scratches the fuck out of the furniture, shits right beside the litter box in the basement, and meows constantly, like a shithead.

palette.provenance: From Daniel's photos of the real Willie (cat_kit/reference/reference-willie-basket.jpg and reference-willie-table.jpg), which override the v0.1 hand-drawn art where they differ: pure white face blaze, muzzle, chest, belly, legs and paws; rich orange tabby as a cap wrapping the top of the head around the ears and down the sides of the cheeks, a LARGE saddle over the whole back and upper sides, and a substantially ginger, ringed tail; green-gold (hazel) eyes; small pink nose. Ginger albedo is #C97020, inside the #C26D1E-#CD7A2A band Daniel specified ('definitely darker orange' than the v0.1 art's #E8AF54): raw photo medians sample muted (#A68041-ish) because of indoor light and shadow, and the game's ACES tonemapping + midday sun desaturate further, so the albedo is set rich and tuned BY EYE against the photos in the standing willie_closeup shot. Tabby striping (ginger_dark #975417) is a fainter, darker banding inside the saddle, cap and tail rings. Tonemapping compensation: albedo picked ~one shade deeper than the naive daylight sample for exactly this reason; if the close-up still reads pale, deepen ginger before touching the lights.
